# SaurioPDF — LLM Reference

PDF generation library for Deno, Node.js, Bun, and browsers.
Rust/WASM core (Krilla) + TypeScript builder API.
JSR: jsr:@sauriopdf/core  |  npm: sauriopdf

---

## SETUP

**Deno / JSR**
```ts
import { init, PDF, loadLiberationSans } from "jsr:@sauriopdf/core";

// Always call init() first — loads the WASM module
await init();
```

**Node.js / Bun (npm)**
```ts
import { init, PDF } from "sauriopdf";   // npm install sauriopdf

// init() detects Node.js automatically and reads the .wasm file via fs.readFileSync.
// No fetch(), no extra config needed. Requires Node.js >= 18.
await init();
```

**Browser (via esm.sh or bundler)**
```html
<script type="module">
  import { init, PDF } from "https://esm.sh/sauriopdf@0.1.0";

  await init(); // loads WASM via fetch() automatically

  const pdf = new PDF({ title: "My Doc" });
  pdf.h1("Hello from browser");
  const bytes = await pdf.generate();

  // Download
  const blob = new Blob([bytes], { type: "application/pdf" });
  const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
  const a = document.createElement("a");
  a.href = url; a.download = "doc.pdf"; a.click();
  URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
</script>
```

PDF generation happens 100% client-side via WASM — no server needed.
Liberation Sans is embedded in the WASM, so no font loading required in browser.
Edge runtimes (Cloudflare Workers, Vercel Edge, Deno Deploy) are NOT supported — WASM is too large.

**General notes**
```ts
// init() is idempotent — safe to call multiple times, initializes only once.
// loadLiberationSans() is OPTIONAL — Liberation Sans is embedded in the WASM.
// Call it only if you need to load fonts from a custom path.
await loadLiberationSans(); // uses default embedded path
```

---

## PDF CLASS

```ts
const pdf = new PDF(opts?: PDFOptions);

interface PDFOptions {
  title?:       string;
  author?:      string;
  subject?:     string;
  keywords?:    string[];
  pageSize?:    "A4" | "A3" | "A5" | "Letter" | "Legal" | "Tabloid"; // default: "A4"
  orientation?: "Portrait" | "Landscape";                             // default: "Portrait"
  margin?:      number | { top: number; right: number; bottom: number; left: number }; // default: 72
  pdfa?:        "1a" | "1b" | "2a" | "2b" | "2u" | "3a" | "3b" | "3u";
}
```

---

## OUTPUT

```ts
// Write to file (Deno, Node.js, Bun)
await pdf.save("output.pdf");

// Get bytes (all runtimes — Deno, Node, Bun, Browser)
const bytes: Uint8Array = await pdf.generate();
```

---

## LAYOUT MODE (auto-cursor, auto page-break)

All layout methods return `this` for chaining.

```ts
pdf.h1("Title")                            // 28pt bold
pdf.h2("Subtitle")                         // 22pt bold
pdf.h3("Section")                          // 17pt bold
pdf.h4("Subsection")                       // 14pt bold

pdf.p("Text", {
  size?:       number,    // default: 11
  color?:      ColorInput,
  align?:      "Left" | "Center" | "Right" | "Justify",
  bold?:       boolean,
  italic?:     boolean,
  lineHeight?: number,    // multiplier, default: 1.4
  font?:       string,    // default: "Liberation Sans"
})

pdf.spacer(16)            // vertical gap in points (default: 16)
pdf.hr({ color?, width? })  // horizontal rule
pdf.newPage()             // force new page

pdf.img(data: Uint8Array, opts?: {
  width?:  number,
  height?: number,
  align?:  "Left" | "Center" | "Right",
})
// Inserts an image at the current cursor position.
// PNG, JPEG, and WebP are auto-detected from magic bytes.
```

---

## TABLE

```ts
pdf.table({
  headers?: string[],       // optional header row
  rows: string[][],         // data rows
  widths?: number[],        // per-column widths:
                            //   ≤1 = fraction of content width (e.g. 0.4 = 40%)
                            //   >1 = absolute points
                            //   omit = auto-computed from content
  striped?: boolean,        // alternate row backgrounds
  borders?: boolean,        // grid lines (default: true)
  fontSize?: number,        // default: 11
  cellPadding?: number,     // default: 6
  rowHeight?: number,       // override auto row height
  headerBg?: ColorInput,    // default: "#2c3e50"
  headerColor?: ColorInput, // default: "#ffffff"
  stripedBg?: ColorInput,   // default: "#f4f6f8"
  rowBg?: ColorInput,       // uniform row background (use striped instead for alternating)
  textColor?: ColorInput,   // default: "#111111"
})
```

Tables auto-paginate — rows that don't fit are carried to the next page.
Row heights are dynamic — computed from wrapped cell content.

---

## SECTION

A boxed region with optional background and border. Supports all layout methods inside.

```ts
pdf.section(
  {
    background?:  ColorInput,
    borderColor?: ColorInput,
    padding?:     number | { top: number; right: number; bottom: number; left: number },
                  // default: 12
    radius?:      number,   // border radius (visual only, not currently rendered)
  },
  (s: PDF) => {
    s.h3("Section Title");
    s.p("Content inside the section.");
    s.table({ ... });       // tables work inside sections too
  }
)
```

Sections reserve space before rendering — they never break across pages.

---

## HEADER / FOOTER

Set before adding content. Both repeat on every page.

```ts
pdf.header(height: number, (ctx: HFContext) => void)
pdf.footer(height: number, (ctx: HFContext) => void)

interface HFContext {
  pageNum:    number;   // 1-indexed
  totalPages: number;   // always correct — injected after all pages committed
  width:      number;   // full page width
  height:     number;   // band height (as passed to header/footer)
  add(...items): void;  // same as pdf.add()
}
```

Coordinate system: (0, 0) = top-left of the band.
Header band: y=0 to y=height, at top of page.
Footer band: y=0 to y=height, at bottom of page.

```ts
// Example
pdf.header(36, (ctx) => {
  ctx.add(rect(0, 0, ctx.width, ctx.height).fill("#1a1a2e"));
  ctx.add(text("My Report").at(24, 24).size(13).bold().color("white"));
});

pdf.footer(24, (ctx) => {
  ctx.add(
    text(`Page ${ctx.pageNum} of ${ctx.totalPages}`)
      .at(0, 8).size(9).color("gray").align("Center").maxWidth(ctx.width)
  );
});
```

---

## MANUAL MODE

Place elements at explicit coordinates. Can be mixed with layout mode.

```ts
pdf.add(...items: (Buildable | RawElement | Array<...>)[])
```

---

## ELEMENT BUILDERS

Import individually:
```ts
import { text, rect, circle, line, path, image, link } from "jsr:@sauriopdf/core";
```

### text(content, x?, y?, size?)
```ts
text("Hello", 50, 100, 14)
  .at(x, y)
  .size(n)
  .bold()
  .italic()
  .color(ColorInput)
  .align("Left" | "Center" | "Right" | "Justify")
  .center()             // shortcut for .align("Center")
  .right()              // shortcut for .align("Right")
  .maxWidth(n)          // enables text wrapping
  .opacity(0..1)
  .font("Liberation Sans")
```

IMPORTANT: `.maxWidth()` enables wrapping. Without it, text is single-line.
When using text() inside header/footer ctx.add(), set maxWidth for centering to work.

### rect(x, y, w, h, opts?)
```ts
rect(50, 100, 200, 80)
  .fill(ColorInput)
  .stroke(ColorInput, strokeWidth?)
  .strokeWidth(n)
  .round(radius?)       // rounded corners, default radius: 8
  .at(x, y)
  .dimensions(w, h)
```

### circle(x, y, radius, opts?)
```ts
circle(297, 400, 60)
  .fill(ColorInput)
  .stroke(ColorInput, strokeWidth?)
  .at(x, y)
  .radius(n)
```

### line(x1, y1, x2, y2, opts?)
```ts
line(50, 200, 545, 200)
  .color(ColorInput)
  .width(n)
```

### path(points, opts?)
```ts
path([[50,100],[200,100],[125,200]])
  .fill(ColorInput)
  .stroke(ColorInput, width?)
  .closed(true)         // default: true
  .open()               // shortcut for .closed(false)
```

### image(data, opts?)
```ts
// data: Uint8Array — PNG, JPEG, or WebP (auto-detected from magic bytes)
image(pngBytes)
  .at(x, y)
  .width(n)
  .height(n)
  .size(w, h)
```

### link(url, x, y, w, h)
```ts
// Clickable annotation overlay — place over text to make it a hyperlink
link("https://example.com", 50, 450, 200, 18)
```

---

## COLOR INPUT

```ts
type ColorInput =
  | string                               // CSS name: "steelblue", "coral", "transparent"
  | string                               // hex: "#rgb", "#rrggbb", "#rrggbbaa"
  | [r: number, g: number, b: number]    // RGB 0-255
  | [r: number, g: number, b: number, a: number]  // RGBA: rgb 0-255, a 0.0-1.0
```

100+ CSS named colors supported (same set as CSS Color Level 4).

---

## PAGE SIZES (in points, 1pt = 1/72 inch)

```
A4:      595 × 842
A3:      842 × 1191
A5:      420 × 595
Letter:  612 × 792
Legal:   612 × 1008
Tabloid: 792 × 1224
```

Content area = page − margins (default 72pt each side).

---

## PDF/A

```ts
// Constructor option
const pdf = new PDF({ pdfa: "2b" });

// Fluent method
pdf.conformsTo("2b");

// Levels: "1a", "1b", "2a", "2b", "2u", "3a", "3b", "3u"
// "2b" is the most common for archival use
```

---

## FONT LOADING

```ts
import { loadLiberationSans, loadFonts, loadFont } from "jsr:@sauriopdf/core";

// Load Liberation Sans from a directory (Deno/Node/Bun/Browser)
await loadLiberationSans("fonts/liberation-fonts-ttf-2.1.5");

// Load a custom font family from Uint8Array
await loadFont("Helvetica", normalBytes, boldBytes?, italicBytes?, boldItalicBytes?);

// Load multiple fonts at once
await loadFonts([
  { name: "MyFont", normal: normalBytes, bold: boldBytes },
]);
```

Liberation Sans is always available — it's embedded in the WASM binary at build time.
Font subsetting is automatic — Krilla only embeds glyphs actually used in the document.

---

## COMPLETE EXAMPLE — Invoice

```ts
import { init, PDF, loadLiberationSans, text, rect } from "jsr:@sauriopdf/core";

await init();

const pdf = new PDF({ title: "Invoice #1042", author: "Acme Corp" });

// Header on every page
pdf.header(48, (ctx) => {
  ctx.add(rect(0, 0, ctx.width, ctx.height).fill("#1a1a2e"));
  ctx.add(text("ACME CORP").at(24, 16).size(16).bold().color("white"));
  ctx.add(text("Invoice").at(ctx.width - 80, 16).size(14).color("#94a3b8"));
});

// Footer with page numbers
pdf.footer(24, (ctx) => {
  ctx.add(
    text(`Page ${ctx.pageNum} of ${ctx.totalPages}`)
      .at(0, 8).size(9).color("gray").align("Center").maxWidth(ctx.width)
  );
});

pdf
  .h1("Invoice #1042")
  .spacer(4)
  .p("Date: March 1, 2026  |  Due: March 31, 2026", { color: "slategray" })
  .spacer(16)

  .section({ background: "#f8fafc", padding: 12 }, (s) => {
    s.p("Bill To:", { bold: true, size: 10, color: "slategray" });
    s.p("Globex Corporation\n742 Evergreen Terrace\nSpringfield, USA");
  })
  .spacer(16)

  .table({
    headers: ["Description", "Qty", "Unit Price", "Total"],
    rows: [
      ["Widget Pro",         "5",  "$19.99",  "$99.95"],
      ["Consulting (hr)",    "3",  "$150.00", "$450.00"],
      ["Support Package",    "1",  "$299.00", "$299.00"],
    ],
    striped:   true,
    headerBg:  "#1a1a2e",
    widths:    [0.45, 0.1, 0.2, 0.25],
  })
  .spacer(8)
  .p("Total: $848.95", { bold: true, align: "Right", size: 13 })
  .spacer(24)
  .p("Payment due within 30 days. Thank you for your business.", {
    color: "slategray",
    align: "Center",
  });

await pdf.save("invoice.pdf");
```

---

## COMMON PATTERNS

### Center text on page
```ts
pdf.p("Centered text", { align: "Center" });
// or in manual mode:
pdf.add(text("Centered").at(margin, y).size(14).center().maxWidth(contentWidth));
```

### Full-width colored header band
```ts
pdf.add(rect(0, 0, 595, 80).fill("#1a1a2e"));
pdf.add(text("Title").at(72, 50).size(24).bold().color("white"));
```

### Page break before a section
```ts
pdf.newPage().h2("New Chapter");
```

### Landscape document
```ts
const pdf = new PDF({ pageSize: "A4", orientation: "Landscape" });
// Page is now 842 × 595
```

### Image in layout
```ts
const imageBytes = await Deno.readFile("logo.png");
pdf.img(imageBytes, { width: 200, height: 100 });
```

### Clickable text link
```ts
// Draw the text, then overlay a link annotation at the same position
pdf.add(text("Visit our website").at(72, 300).size(11).color("steelblue"));
pdf.add(link("https://example.com", 72, 285, 160, 18));
```

---

## ARCHITECTURE NOTES (for contributors)

- ALL layout math (cursor, wrapping, alignment, tables) is in TypeScript
- Krilla/Rust only receives pre-positioned elements via JSON
- Text wrapping: TypeScript calls wrapLines() → one RawElement per line
- Alignment: computed as x-offset before sending to Rust
- Tables: decomposed into rects + lines + text elements in TypeScript
- Font subsetting: automatic in Krilla (tracks glyphs during draw_text, subsets on finish())
- Page coordinate system: (0,0) = top-left, y increases downward, unit = points
- Coordinate space: absolute page coordinates (not relative to margins)
- Header/footer elements injected AFTER all pages committed (so totalPages is known)

Source layout:
  mod.ts            — main entry point
  src/types.ts      — all types
  src/colors.ts     — CSS color parsing
  src/layout.ts     — wrapLines(), alignmentOffset(), estimateTextHeight()
  src/elements.ts   — TextElement, RectElement, CircleElement, LineElement, PathElement, ImageElement, LinkElement
  src/table.ts      — buildTableElements() + autoColWidths()
  src/pdf.ts        — PDF class, shiftEl(), quickPDF()
  src/wasm.ts       — WASM singleton init
  lib/font-loader.ts — universal font loading (Deno/Node/Browser)
  rust-core/        — Rust/WASM source (Krilla)
  wasm/             — compiled WASM output (committed)
  fonts/            — Liberation Sans TTF files (embedded via include_bytes!)
